title: CI/CD
description: Can wire build, test and quality gates so a red pipeline blocks merge — and can deploy from the pipeline, not a laptop.

levels.name: Foundation
levels.description: Can commit a pipeline file that runs on every push and point at the step that would fail a broken test — under written guidance.

levels.name: Apprentice
levels.description: Can run lint and tests on every push and pull or merge request, show a deliberately broken commit failing CI and the fix turning it green, and document that merge is blocked while the pipeline is red.

levels.name: Practitioner
levels.description: Can independently add a container build tagged with the git SHA, run tests against that image rather than only host packages, and add a quality gate whose threshold is justified and shown failing on a deliberate violation.

levels.name: Journeyman
levels.description: Can diagnose a pipeline that is green on the laptop and red in CI — or the reverse — cite the missing service, image or gate, and produce a deploy job that applies a versioned artifact and smoke-checks it so a laptop-only deploy is no longer the path.

levels.name: Mastery Evidence
levels.description: Can review another apprentice's workflow, name a gate that is toil or vanity, and teach when to fail the build versus warn on an unfamiliar repository.
